test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: The school has made computer training compulsory for all students.

Conclusions:

I. Computer knowledge is essential in the modern world.

II All students will become computer experts.
solution:
GIven:

Statement:

The school has made computer training compulsory for all students.

Conclusion I: Computer knowledge is essential in the modern world.

This is a logical reason why the school might have made training compulsory.

It follows from the statement. ✅

Conclusion II: All students will become computer experts.

The statement only says training is compulsory, not that everyone will become an expert.

So this conclusion does not follow. ❌

This, Only Conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
